template_data.headline_html: Five SAM.gov gaps that silently block awards.

items.title: Registration status
items.sub: Active, expired, or pending — pending holds up awards

items.title: NAICS codes
items.sub: Must match what you're actually quoting on

items.title: CAGE code accuracy
items.sub: Entity name and EIN must be exact — mismatches flag COs

items.title: Points of contact
items.sub: Right people, working emails — stale contacts lose RFQs

items.title: Renewal date
items.sub: 365-day cycle moves fast — don't let it lapse mid-bid
